title: Reference
description: A pointer to another entity. Cross-domain links MUST be references, never inlined copies of the target entity. The optional @type and name are display hints for consumers that will not dereference; they are not authoritative and MUST NOT be relied on.

@id.description: Absolute IRI of the referenced entity.

@type.description: The referenced entity's type, as a display hint.

name.description: The referenced entity's name, as a display hint.
